name: Name
intro: A calmer place to plan, track and grow. All your finances, beautifully connected.
emptyHint: Add your first item to build your financial picture.
noResultsHint: Try a different search or clear your filters.
deleteHint: This action cannot be undone. Linked records may prevent deletion.
drop: Drop a receipt here or choose a file
fileHint: PDF, PNG or JPEG · up to 5 MB
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Changing your password signs out all sessions.
importHint: CSV adds transactions. Account and category names must match existing records. Importing twice creates duplicates.
backupHint: JSON includes financial records and receipts (up to 64 MB). Restore into a profile without accounts, budgets, goals or debts. Its categories will be replaced. Passwords, sessions, preferences and activity history are excluded.
currencyHint: One base currency per profile. Currency changes are allowed only before creating accounts. No automatic exchange rates.
goalHint: Allocated savings track your plan; they do not move money or add to net worth.
debtHint: Record principal payments here. Interest is descriptive; record interest charges as separate expenses.
recurringHint: Due operations are posted when you open the app or run the local scheduler. Future entries do not affect today's balances.
invalidInput: Check the fields and enter valid values.
inUse: This item has linked records. Remove those records first.
unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
serverError: The request failed. Check the local server and database.
invalidTransfer: Choose two different accounts for a transfer.
categoryMismatch: The category must match the operation type.
unsupportedFile: Use a PDF, PNG or JPEG file.
importMapping: Account or category references do not match.
restoreEmptyOnly: Restore requires a profile without accounts.
currencyMismatch: Backup currency must match your profile currency.
currencyLocked: Currency cannot change while accounts exist.
debtPaymentLocked: Linked principal payments must be deleted before changing debt amounts or editing this operation.
localOnly: Your data stays on your server
createHint: Start with a clean profile. Sample data is available in the seeded demo account.
netWorthHint: Balances + receivables − debts, as of today.
sortHint: All amounts are in your base currency.
partialTranslation: Core translation; remaining labels use English
notificationHint: Reminders are generated locally on app open and refresh.
noUpcoming: No payments due in the next 30 days.
accountRequired: Create an account before adding transactions.
localDate: Dates use your local calendar selection; scheduled processing uses UTC.
a11yChart: Income and expense trends; exact values are listed below.
allocationHint: Update the allocated savings total through Edit.
debtSummary: Principal tracked; no automatic interest accrual.
renameData: Category and account names are your own data and are not automatically translated.
